name: When do I need professional water damage restoration versus handling it myself?

mainEntity.name: When do I need professional water damage restoration versus handling it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need professional water damage restoration when the damage is significant, involves sewage or contaminated water, or affects structural components. Professionals have specialized equipment for thorough water extraction, drying, and moisture detection that goes beyond surface-level solutions. They can also identify hidden moisture, prevent mold growth effectively, and ensure proper sanitization. Attempting to handle extensive damage yourself can lead to incomplete drying, persistent mold issues, and further structural problems. For minor, clean water spills, immediate personal cleanup might be sufficient, but anything more complex warrants expert intervention.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional restoration is needed for significant damage, contaminated water, or structural concerns; DIY is only for minor, clean water spills.
